definition: a plate or bowl for holding or serving food
description: A golden hamster sits on a white kitchen counter beside the sink, eating a green scouring pad out of a small round white dish. A white box like a phone box is set down next to the dish and a second hamster peeks in from the right. The hamster leaves the dish, sniffs along the edge of the box and nibbles at its lid until the box opens to show a yellow and green sponge inside, then rears up on its back legs.

en.question: What is the orange hamster doing?

de.answer: Der orangefarbene Hamster frisst aus einer Schale.
